empirical_gap_assessment.critical_limitation: Public Space Agency Data Gap regarding Micro-Level Equipment Procurement & Resource Quantities
empirical_gap_assessment.explanation: While space agencies (NASA, ESA, ISRO, JAXA) publish mission milestones, flight trajectories, scientific telemetry, and macro-budgetary appropriations, granular month-by-month bills of materials (BOM), exact discrete component demand quantities (e.g., number of Rad-750 processors, reaction wheels, or optical transceivers procured monthly), and precise consumable propellant burn logs are classified under International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), national security protocols, and commercial confidentiality (SpaceX, Blue Origin proprietary supply contracts).
empirical_gap_assessment.scientific_resolution: To enable rigorous Big Data engineering, distributed analytics (Hadoop/HDFS/Hive/Spark), and demand forecasting, Orbitalytics implements a controlled, reproducible, physics-informed synthetic data generation module. All synthetic records are explicitly tagged with data_origin='synthetic' and is_synthetic=True, ensuring strict transparency, provenance traceability, and zero confounding with authentic historical observations.
